_doc: ACTIONS WHOSE DECLARED EFFECTS ARE A `- log:` STUB, classified.
TWO SECTIONS, and they mean different things.
`known_divergences` -- an action implemented in ONE active port. Every row
is a PRIME DIRECTIVE VIOLATION that is ruled and scheduled, not accepted.
Each carries `asserts` verified on every run, written so they go RED WHEN
THE DIVERGENCE IS FIXED: the row cannot outlive the defect it describes.
Ruled at council 2026-07-30 (O1); queued as Stubb's first stones.
`bypassed` -- declared, named by no dispatch table, but the FEATURE works
natively behind another entry point. Thirteen TRACED rows (2 on 2026-10-26, 11 Layers-row controls on 2026-10-27); add none on a guess. Actions with no
dispatch entry (the gate prints how many) form a bucket that MIXES unbuilt with bypassed; the known
bypassed family is the Layers row controls (eye/lock/twirl/rename/select),
which live in `lp_tree`'s row template (`do`) -- which no native port reads, since both
draw tree rows natively. They are not listed because separating them needs
TRACING, and this file's author tried to shortcut it by guessing native
function names and got one of three. A row added on a guess is the
confident-and-wrong claim this mechanism exists to prevent.

bypassed.close_window: TRACED 2026-10-26 (jas, item 8 class H): no port's dispatch table names it because each shell closes its own window. Windows: the engine names it in its reply (`close_window: true`) and prototypes/sb_winui/Canvas.cs closes on it. Mac: quit is native (JasCommands' NSApplication.shared.terminate, JasApp.applicationShouldTerminate). Web: no window of its own, a no-op the action's description states.
bypassed.save_all_then_close: TRACED 2026-10-26 (jas, item 8 class H): the save-then-close is the shell's. Windows: the engine names it in its reply (`save_all_then_close: true`) and prototypes/sb_winui/Canvas.cs saves, then closes. Mac: quit is native (JasApp.applicationShouldTerminate). Web: no window of its own, a no-op the action's description states.
bypassed.solo_element_visibility: TRACED 2026-10-27 (jas, item 35, the per-port feature trace): both ports draw the Layers tree natively and never read `lp_tree`'s row template (`do` since item 38). Rust: Alt-click on the eye, jas_dioxus/src/interpreter/renderer.rs:8125-8204. Swift: Option-click, JasSwift/Sources/Interpreter/YamlPanelBodyView.swift:4258-4300.
bypassed.layers_select_all: TRACED 2026-10-27 (jas, item 35, the per-port feature trace): both ports draw the Layers tree natively and never read `lp_tree`'s row template (`do` since item 38). Rust: Cmd/Ctrl+A in the tree, jas_dioxus/src/interpreter/renderer.rs:7987-8020. Swift: Cmd-A in the key monitor, JasSwift/Sources/Interpreter/YamlPanelBodyView.swift:4173-4176. Neither scopes to visible or isolation.
bypassed.scroll_to_selected: TRACED 2026-10-27 (jas, item 35, the per-port feature trace): both ports draw the Layers tree natively and never read `lp_tree`'s row template (`do` since item 38). Render behaviour, bound by no panel, menu or shortcut: Rust expands ancestors and scrolls on every render, jas_dioxus/src/interpreter/renderer.rs:7692-7727 (scroll is wasm only). Swift: JasSwift/Sources/Interpreter/YamlPanelBodyView.swift:4101-4141.
